tasks.short: Direct and review survey staff work

steps.what: Review actual interviewer work, survey returns and support records against the study protocol in the {OTHER} survey collection system
Direct and review the work of staff members, including survey support staff and interviewers who gather survey data, through actual guidance and discussion of reviewed cases
Enter actual review findings and agreed corrective work in the {OTHER} survey review record, checking meaning and exact case references
Save the review entry in the same {OTHER} survey record

tasks.design: Configure exact case and study-reference defaults in the {OTHER} survey review form. The researcher personally reviews staff work, discusses it and writes and checks the findings; the tool neither rates staff nor generates corrective instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review records may repeat study and case identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked review forms can reuse those identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Protocol deviations and staff explanations require contextual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher distinguishes a data-quality issue from an unsupported inference about an interviewer.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for survey-data access and national staff consultation if monitoring changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact case-reference defaults can reduce review-record repetition while staff assessment remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual work review, discussion and an existing review entry. Interviewers and support staff produce returns and operational records during ordinary collection; s1 reads and checks them. Missing context is obtained manually, not treated as a clean performance feed.

S3 counts all capture of findings and corrective meaning. Only exact study/case fields default; mismatches require manual reconciliation. No invented report after every staff conversation. If actual records are absent remove that work and recalculate.

Native configuration first; existing defaults earn no gain. The save is negligible active work, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated, without author self-approval. Actual guidance is delivered in s2; the save sends no message.
Work shared with scheduling in 7556 is counted once. Shares are provisional active effort, not a measured supervision baseline.
research_questions: Which review fields are repeated manually without contributing to judgement?

already_counted.description: Work review, staff discussion and full findings capture/checks remain.

incremental.description: Check review reference defaults after study configuration changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=96.2, gross=3.8; upkeep 1 gives net 2.8. Low zero when identifiers already default, so do not introduce duplicate configuration. Actual staff review does not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct changes to survey implementation and methods

steps.what: Read actual implementation issues, current and proposed questionnaire versions and method evidence in {DOCS}
Compare exact question text, identifiers and recorded routing-rule definitions between the selected versions in {DOCS}
Determine actual method and implementation changes, considering bias, routing behaviour, respondent burden and field evidence
Write the actual change instructions and rationale in {DOCS}, checking the whole instruction and required tests against original versions
Save the working instruction in the same {DOCS} change file
Direct updates and changes in survey implementation and methods through actual discussion with implementation staff, resolving questions and follow-up evidence

tasks.design: Use native version comparison in {DOCS} to show exact questionnaire and recorded rule changes. The researcher interprets effects, writes the complete instruction and directs staff; literal differences do not establish methodological validity or authorize a live survey change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual side-by-side transcription can obscure which text or rule definition changed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version comparison can produce the exact difference artefact.
tasks.still_hard: Bias, routing effects and comparability across waves need method expertise and testing.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher decides whether a seemingly small change alters the meaning of the survey.

ambition.what: No autonomous method or live-survey change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for study access and workflow consultation under national rules where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact document-version differences are deterministic, while the methodological significance of survey changes requires human evaluation.

assumptions: Representative episode contains existing current and proposed versions and an actual written change instruction. Study staff produce those versions and implementation evidence in normal work; s1 identifies and checks the exact pair. Missing or non-comparable rules require manual comparison, not an assumed structured feed.

S2 explicitly produces the proposed literal comparison, without inferring semantic equivalence or executing routing logic. S3-s4 retain all decisions, input capture, writing and original-source checks. Native comparison first; its existing use earns no new gain.

S6 is actual direction and discussion, not a hidden live deployment, bulk notice or final survey release. Implementation staff's existing change and test work remains unchanged. A concrete deployment or formal instruction send needs its own actual final-version authority and action; this save does neither.
Same-system save is minimum share 1 for negligible active effort, fully retained and ungated without self-approval. Shares are hypotheses, not measured method-change times.
research_questions: Which comparisons are genuinely manual rather than existing version-diff runtime?

already_counted.description: Source verification, methodological judgement, complete instruction writing and staff direction remain.

incremental.description: Check version-comparison coverage after questionnaire format changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross=20; upkeep 3 gives net 17. Conservative case: differing formats leave only 5 comparison points avoidable, giving 5-3=2. Method judgement, tests and staff direction retain their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify actual questionnaire history, collection protocols, sampling design and weighting decision records and capture documentation section selections in {DOCS}
Copy exact versions, question identifiers, sample definitions and recorded weighting parameters into the {DOCS} method-documentation template
Produce documentation of the questionnaire development process, data collection methods, sampling designs, and decisions related to sample statistical weighting

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory wording from actual recorded method decisions
loop.input: Verified source pack and populated method fields
loop.output: Narrative with a source pointer for every methodological assertion
loop.check: Researcher compares the whole narrative with original protocols and decision records in s4
loop.stop: Missing rationale, unsupported assertion or conflicting version returns to manual writing; never invent a design or weighting decision
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle fixed fields; a bounded wording draft is only for varied explanatory prose

steps.what: Complete and correct the full documentation, checking design meaning, omissions, versions, denominators and weighting rationale against original sources
Save the documentation in the same {DOCS} working file

tasks.design: Configure exact methodological field population in {DOCS}, then draft variable explanations only from verified decision records. The researcher completes the entire document against original sources; no method choice, weighting rationale or missing process history is invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: Documentation requires repeated field copying and prose composition around existing decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates plus constrained source-grounded drafting can assist these separate operations.
tasks.still_hard: An accurate-looking description can conceal an omitted design limitation or wrong version.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher knows what was actually done and which limitations matter.

ambition.what: No claim of new survey validity or autonomous methodology.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for study-source access, privacy review and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked template fields and bounded narrative drafting can assist method documentation while requiring complete methodological verification.

assumptions: Boundary is producing actual method documentation, not conducting the study or selecting weights. Study staff produce protocols and decision records in existing research work; s1 verifies versions and counts all section selection and missing-source recovery. If rationale was never recorded, the researcher reconstructs it manually with evidence rather than receiving a free structured feed.

Exact fields are study/version identifiers, question references, sample definitions, collection dates and recorded weighting parameters and decisions. S2 explicitly copies them. Native templates first; existing population earns no gain. Use a narrative loop only where fixed templates do not suffice.

S3 retains edits and manual fallback; s4 retains complete meaning and original-source checks. A same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without self-approval. Public release or external delivery, if present, is a separate actual authorized action after the final version exists.
Do not duplicate method-change rationale already written in 7557. Shares and cuts are provisional, not measured documentation baselines.
research_questions: Can native templates cover the actual explanation without a model?

already_counted.description: Source capture, drafting edits and full documentation meaning checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain section mappings and audit outputs after template or model changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=61, gross=39; upkeep 5 gives net 34. Conservative case: incomplete history requires full manual prose and only 12 copying points are avoidable, giving 12-5=7. No design or weighting decision effort is reduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write proposals for new survey projects

steps.what: Read actual client requirements and verified study capabilities, and capture the researcher's proposed design, effort, assumptions and exclusions in {DOCS}
Populate exact project references, dates, capability references and chosen scope fields in the {DOCS} proposal template
Write proposals to win new projects, explaining the chosen survey approach, deliverables and limitations

loop.purpose: Draft proposal wording from the researcher's actual scope and verified capabilities
loop.input: Verified proposal source pack and selected scope
loop.output: Narrative with source pointers and unresolved fields left blank
loop.check: Researcher checks every promise, method claim, effort statement and exclusion against original sources in s4
loop.stop: Unsupported experience, missing price or changed scope returns to human scoping and manual writing; invent no client case or commitment
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle fixed fields; variable client-specific explanations need bounded wording assistance only

steps.what: Complete and correct the whole proposal, checking methodology, feasibility, references, commitments and exclusions against the source requirements
Save the completed working proposal in the same {DOCS} file without submitting it

tasks.design: Configure proposal field reuse in {DOCS} and offer a bounded narrative draft from actual requirements and scoping decisions. The researcher supplies the method and commitments and completes the full proposal; the system neither invents credentials nor submits an offer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposal authors repeatedly assemble capability facts and explain already chosen approaches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and source-bounded drafting can assist those writing operations.
tasks.still_hard: Feasible study design, uncertain effort and defensible commitments remain human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher recognises when a requested survey cannot answer the client's question.

ambition.what: No assumed increase in wins or new client group.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for capability and client-source access, confidentiality review and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: templates and bounded drafting can assist proposal writing from verified scope without making commercial commitments.

assumptions: Boundary is writing the proposal, not submitting or accepting a contract. Client staff produce the actual brief and record owners supply existing capability evidence; s1 reads and checks them and counts the researcher's actual design, effort selection and structured capture. Missing facts remain unresolved for manual scoping, not generated baselines or experience claims.

S2 explicitly populates exact selected fields. Native templates first; existing reused fields earn no gain. S3 includes edits and manual fallback, and s4 preserves complete original-source and commitment checking. No future win rate or price benchmark is invented.

Ordinary authoring checks are not a new self-approval. Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. Actual commercial approval and submission, if part of a wider episode, must follow the final proposal with their real actors and separate send; this writing workflow does not issue it.
Shares are provisional active work, not measured proposal-writing times; client clarification and other staff labour are not newly assumed free.
research_questions: Which proposal sections can be completed with native fields and which need original narrative?

already_counted.description: Requirements reading, design and scope capture, draft editing and full commitment checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain proposal mappings and inspect source support after template/model changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65, gross=35; upkeep 4 gives net 31. Conservative case: a novel study needs fully manual narrative and only 6 field-copying points are avoidable, giving 6-4=2. All design and commitment checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated comparison and document assembly; staff judgement, method decisions and proposal commitments remain with the researcher.
reach: Survey implementation specialist: learn version comparison limits and live-change controls.
skills_to_grow: Trace every methodological assertion to a real decision
Separate proposal writing from commercial issue
role.ambitious_version: A researcher with traceable survey changes and method documents who retains the study's scientific and staff decisions.
